subject.title: sandbox: keep workspaceAccess none workspaces writable

question: Should the sandbox/security owner sponsor the narrow isolated-writable `workspaceAccess: "none"` fix now, with proof that writes stay inside the sandbox-owned workspace?
rationale: The product direction is mostly confirmed by maintainer discussion, but the implementation changes sandbox filesystem write authorization and needs explicit security-boundary ownership before automation or merge.

options.title: Sponsor Narrow Isolated-Writable Fix
options.body: Update only the sandbox-owned `/workspace` writability for `none`, keep the real agent workspace unmounted, and leave writable custom host binds to the separate open policy issue.

options.title: Fold Into Writable-Bind Policy
options.body: Defer this fix until the broader writable custom-bind policy defines one mount-aware write contract for `workspaceAccess: "none"`.

options.title: Keep Current Read-Only None
options.body: Keep the current fail-closed behavior and update docs/support guidance, superseding the maintainer comment that redirected work back to this issue.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Narrow Isolated-Writable Fix
recommendation.body: Update only the sandbox-owned `/workspace` writability for `none`, keep the real agent workspace unmounted, and leave writable custom host binds to the separate open policy issue.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the latest explicit maintainer direction on the closed strict-gating PR and have recent central history on the sandbox helper surface.
